review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and reliability of LAN, WAN, and wireless networks that support business operations. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies, and a passion for maintaining stable and secure IT environments. Key Responsibilities Administer, monitor, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, wireless networks
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies, and a passion for maintaining stable and secure IT environments. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, security standards, and audit requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related discipline. 3 years of experience in network administration, network operations, or network engineering. Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches. Technical Skills Routing Static Routing OSPF EIGRP Basic BGP Concepts Route Redistribution Route Summarization Switching VLANs Trunking STP/RSTP Inter-VLAN Routing EtherChannel Switch Stack Management Network Fundamentals TCP/IP DNS DHCP NAT ARP ICMP SNMP NTP Preferred Qualifications Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).
